cobeffectiveness.config.title: Cobblemon Effectiveness
cobeffectiveness.config.panel_name.tip: Names the Pokemon you are facing and shows its own types.
cobeffectiveness.config.panel_types.tip: Which attack types are strong or weak against the opponent.
cobeffectiveness.config.panel_moves.tip: Scores each of your four moves against the opponent. Hidden until it is your turn.
cobeffectiveness.config.hover_only.tip: Show the panels only while the pointer is over an opponent's battle tile.
cobeffectiveness.config.row.tip: Show a %s row in the effectiveness panel.
cobeffectiveness.config.move.tip: Drag each panel where you want it. They snap to each other.
cobeffectiveness.config.reset.tip: Put every setting and all three panel positions back to how they started.
cobeffectiveness.config.position_hint: Drag any panel to move it. They snap to each other.
